blocks.html: Masonry structures and components shall comply with the requirements in Chapter 7 of TMS 402 depending on the structure's seismic design category as determined in Section 1613 of this code. All masonry walls, unless isolated on three edges from in-plane motion of the basic structural systems, shall be considered to be part of the seismic-force-resisting system.
